### Data aggregation & dissemination for the notes of the Unit 4 - Network & Communication aspects in IoT in the subject of Internet of Things

* Data aggregation: Combining data from multiple sources into unified view. Eg: Combining sensor data from multiple devices to get overall status of a system.
* Reasons for data aggregation:
    * Reduce data volume: Large amount of data generated by IoT devices can be overwhelming. Aggregation reduces volume by combining & condensing data.
    * Pattern identification: Aggregated data can reveal patterns & trends that would be difficult to see with raw data. Eg: Identifying peak usage times from energy usage data.
    * Single point of access: Aggregated data can be accessed from single source rather than accessing each device individually.
* Methods for data aggregation:
    * Edge aggregation: Aggregation done by local gateway. Eg: Aggregating data from sensors in a single building.
    * Cloud aggregation: Aggregation done by cloud platform. Eg: Aggregating data from all buildings in a city.
* Challenges in data aggregation:
    * Heterogeneity: Data from different sources may be in different formats, have different meanings, etc. Normalization required to aggregate.
    * Scale: As number & types of IoT devices grow, aggregating data at large scale can be difficult. Require powerful platforms & algorithms.
    * Latency: Some applications require real-time aggregation & response which can be challenging with large amount of data & resources.
    * Security & privacy: Mechanisms required to securely aggregate data from different sources & maintain privacy.
* Data dissemination: Spreading aggregated data/insights to other systems/users. Done through APIs, dashboards, reports, etc.
